description: Report whether Puppet Server keeps the CA in the pe-ca database or on the filesystem, by checking /etc/puppetlabs/puppetserver/bootstrap.cfg, /etc/puppetlabs/puppetserver/services.d/*.cfg and /opt/puppetlabs/server/apps/puppetserver/config/services.d/*.cfg. Returns backend (database, filesystem or unknown when none of those files exists), the file that matched, and the paths checked.
